tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// bka' gdams do kor ba'i zhu ba bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gsung rab la// rang dbang thob pa'i skyes chen khyod// snyan pa'i grags pas 'dzam gling khyab// mi yi seng ge rgyal gyur cig /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan khyod drung du// dge slong rdo rje seng ge yis// dri ba cung zad zhu ba la// sngags kyi dbang bskur ma thob par// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// bla mas gnang ba byin pa des// gsang sngags nyams su blang rung ngam// gang zag sdom pa sum ldan cig /spang blang phan tshun nang 'gal tshe// sdom gsum gang gi dbang du bgyi// skyabs 'gro smon 'jug gnyis dang ni// dam tshig rnams kyi thun tshod gang*// gsang sngags pha rgyud ma rgyud dang*// phyi nang gnyis dang rgyud sde bzhi// khyad par mdo rgyud bsdus pa zhu// rig 'dzin sdom pa'i ngo bo gang*// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa gnyis// don la 'gal ba cang mchis sam// dbu tshad gnyis kyi khyad par dang*// bden gnyis dbye ba ji ltar bzhed// don dam shes bya yin nam min// kun rdzob legs par rtogs tsam na// don dam logs su cang lus sam// sa la gnas pa'i byang sems la// mnyam rjes gnyis la khyad ci yod// thub pa'i ye shes ji lta bu// rten la rab gnas byed pa'i tshe// chos skur byin gyis brlab pa dang*// ye shes sems dpa' dgug pa gnyis// byin rlabs khyad par yod lags sam// sangs rgyas pa yi chos rnams kun// bsdu na nyams len ci ltar byed// de nyid bcu de gang la bzhed// gang zag dbang po rab de la// sa lam nges par yod dam ci// lha sku'i ngo bo gcig shes pas// gcig 'grub thams cad 'grub mi 'grub// gzhan yang rigs lnga ser 'byam dang*// gson po'i bum pa byed pa la// mi mnyes zer ba g.yar gyis khums// 'di yi rgyu mtshan thugs la thogs// bstan pa rin chen sgor zhugs te// thos bsam cung zad gzhir byas nas// nyams len chos dang bstun pa na// blo la the tshom skyes pa rnams// bshes gnyen dam pas bsal bar zhu// spyan sngar mjal bar sems spro yang*// rkyen dang ma ldan rngo ma thogs// tshul dang mi mthun nyes pa yi// skyon du gyur pa bzod par gsol// 'gro don shar du mdzad nas kyang*// dbus gtsang thugs kyis mi gtang bar// slar yang mi yi seng ge khyod// bstan pa yun du 'dzin par zhu// bka' gdams do kor ba'i zhu ba dge'o//
// ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
